source: Designer MVP rules sheet (Oct 8 2026), section 5 'Expected timeline' (designer-sim estimates, not real-sim results) and section 7 step 2 (15 s tolerance). Scenario data/balance/scenarios/columbia_gorge_100mi_mvp.json, Normal difficulty. Baseline: the #18 headless log (merged as 854daba), main 996c80a. Retargeted after PR #18 (head 5db79ae): the Dalles arrivals and captures, remnant_tier2 and compact_at_1 now follow the real sim (straight node-to-node road stepping at wheeled 1200 cm/tick, arrival = first battalion inside the 1.5 mi capture disk). Pass 2 (dataVersion 9): wording only, compact_militia made advisory; no tick or tolerance changed. The other targets are still designer-sim estimates.

lines.baseline: Compact takes The Dalles at about 7:46. The Remnant keeps its third motor rifle battalion at home.
lines.remnant_commit: The Remnant commits its third motor rifle battalion to The Dalles, takes it at about 7:02, builds the forward depot at node 614 and drives on Hood River.

targets.description: First Compact battalion enters the capture disk of The Dalles (town 14, territory 4, key 0x10000000B3787512; town-class disk 241402 cm = 1.5 mi). The Compact prize force (scouts + 2 rifles) leaves Hood River at tick 1288 and follows the sim's road movement: straight node-to-node over 11 waypoints at the wheeled 1200 cm/tick. Measured 3683 on PR #18 head 5db79ae (was 4560 from the designer sim's road lengths). Same in both lines. Must arrive before the Remnant: see orderChecks compact_first_at_dalles.

First Remnant group (starting force: 2 motor rifles + recon) enters the capture disk of The Dalles (1.5 mi). It leaves Goldendale at tick 40 and follows the sim's road movement: straight node-to-node over 17 waypoints at the wheeled 1200 cm/tick. The route is Goldendale node 953 to The Dalles node 499, 5272961 cm (32.8 road-mi) by road length; the straight legs are shorter. Measured 3976 on PR #18 head 5db79ae (was 5180 from the designer sim).

Compact completes the capture of The Dalles (baseline line: the Remnant does not commit a third rifle battalion). Moved by the same -880 ticks as compact_dalles_arrive (was 10200). The capture lands on tick a+N (LD1); there is no reset on contest.

Remnant completes the capture of The Dalles (commit line: the Remnant commits its third motor rifle battalion). Moved by the same -1200 ticks as remnant_dalles_arrive (was 9640). The capture lands on tick a+N (LD1); there is no reset on contest.
Remnant Tier II research completes (autoResearch tier2: starts at notBeforeTick 1200, researchTicks 1800, so it completes at 3000). Measured 3000 on PR #18 head 5db79ae (was 3020).
Second raised remnant_mech_battalion completes; the strike group (3 armour + 2 mech + 2 rifles) is ready.

Compact militia completion from the rules sheet 5 row 'Compact militia / AT' (MVP estimate 3:15). Stale: on #18 the Compact's starting militia is logged at tick 0 and the AI does not raise militia, so 3900 never matches a real run. Advisory until the raise log distinguishes raised from starting units: reported but never fails the check. See the open question in docs/design/mvp-acceptance.md.

Compact AI issues the raise order for its first compact_at_battalion (raise start, not completion). Reference value 1948 is the AT order tick in the signed-off Compact raise order (L, L, AT ordered at 648 / 1248 / 1948) on PR #18 (was 5700, the rules sheet 5 estimate 4:45 for completion). Advisory: reported but never fails the check.
Remnant forward supply_depot at road node 614 (The Dalles) completes. The sheet gives this as 'about 10:39' on the commit line.
Remnant strike group arrives at Hood River after the 44.4 road-mile tracked drive.
Remnant captures the Compact HQ holding at Hood River: Remnant win. Lower bound against a passive Compact with no counterattack.

orderChecks.description: Design requirement: the Compact reaches The Dalles first, by a few hundred ticks (measured margin 293 on PR #18 head 5db79ae). margin = remnant_dalles_arrive - compact_dalles_arrive. FAIL if the margin is below minMarginTicks (the Compact is not strictly first, or either event is missing). WARN, without failing, if the margin is below warnBelowTicks.
